visual_review: A round globe with the Lucide meridian ellipse and equator, on a short stem and flat base; mirrored about x=24 and reads as a desk globe at 48 in both themes.
omissions: The side meridian ring of the reference (no room for a concentric ring 8 clear of a gridded ball) and the rounded foot, drawn as a flat base line.
